sources: https://koa.com/campgrounds/yellowstone-park/reserve/ (KOA booking form: RV, 2 adults, 23-ft motorhome, no slide-outs, 2027-06-15 to 06-16, read in a browser)

values.note: KOA booking form, 1 night 2027-06-15 (Tue), 23-ft motorhome, before tax: back-in 30/20-amp water/electric $99; pull-thru water/electric $109; back-in 30/20-amp full hookups $109; pull-thru full hookups $132; 50-amp patio sites $139 (back-in) and $164 (pull-thru).

fees.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/yellowstone-park/reserve/ (step 2 site list, '$99.00 avg/night | Back In, 30/20 Amps, Water/Electric' ... '$164.00 avg/night | Pull Thru, 50/30/20 Amps, Full Hookups, Patio'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/yellowstone-park/ ('50 Max Amp'; 'full hookups with 50-, 30- or 20-amp electricity connections') + booking form site types, read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/yellowstone-park/ ("77' Max Length"; 'several Back-In or Pull-Thru RV Sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Heated indoor pool (Memorial Day - Labor Day), West Gate Cafe and Coffee Cabin (Memorial Day - Labor Day), Kamping Kitchen, propane, firewood, cable TV, dog park, bike rentals; fire ring at each site (fires allowed unless a burn ban is in place).

facilities.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/yellowstone-park/amenities/ ('Shop Necessities and Souvenirs at the Camp Store', 'Wi-Fi', 'Heated Indoor Pool', 'Propane', 'Kamping Kitchen', 'Cable TV', 'Bike Rentals', 'Fire Rings at each site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Extra 5% off for military veterans, service members, police, firefighters and first responders who are KOA Rewards members (ID at check-in, Rewards number at booking); site fees only, not on stays of 28+ days.

discounts.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/yellowstone-park/ ('This KOA is proud to offer a special Thank You to all KOA Rewards Campers that are military veterans, service men and women, police, firefighters and first responders. Enjoy an extra 5% off your stay'), read 2026-10-22

note: KOA Holiday at 3305 Targhee Pass Highway, a few miles west of West Yellowstone and the park's West Entrance; wooded RV sites, tent village and cabins. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on koa.com and its booking form: $99-164 (mid-June 2027 weeknight, before tax), reservable online, water and sewer, pull-throughs, phone 406-646-7606. Added 50-amp, 77-ft max length, camp store/Wi-Fi/indoor pool, season May 19 - Oct 1, and a 5% military/first-responder discount for KOA Rewards members. Not stated: site count, showers/laundry as listed amenities. Note trimmed of the hookup, price and rating lines.
flags: Price gate: base $99/night (back-in water/electric, mid-June 2027 weeknight) is over US$50; the Yellowstone NP gateway applies (9 km, gateways.py), as the inclusion evidence already says.
